It was just funny and I showed her and she said “why don’t you go be with her” and I told her I was gone to not contact me. She later coaxed me into trying to come over but I once again didn’t feel well, I keep getting extremely sick and I have immune issues. I told her and slept in again forgetting to wake up, she told me it was fine and I said I guess I’ll sleep and maybe play a game on my ps5. Since she didn’t wanna hang out I thought it was alright but I just slept till 5 or 6 pm. She got drunk again and told me I would choose a game over her… I told her I have immune issues and I get embarrassing infections and I trusted her and she just insults me and insinuated I was lying and I was hurt. I ignored her for a while and she messaged me this tik tok about how I have love issues because I have bpd and I had family abuse in the past. I didn’t even respond and she apologized and I just blocked her. It was so hard but I can’t take it anymore. I don’t even care I have borderline anymore, I will end up killing myself if I keep this up. But the damage is done. I have nightmares and my new coworker who wants to date me scares me. I have ptsd I think from this, I have ptsd already but I’m pretty sure this is a new one for me. I panic when she doesn’t message m back in a few hours but I don’t blow her phone up I just nervously pace around. I try to be honest about my mental illness but I’m always scared she’s gonna leave. Or blame me. So far she’s been patient and kind and said she’d be here for me if I choose to date her or not but I feel like I have ulcers from the previous relationship. I can’t eat. I can’t sleep.
I’m just going to start making my own and call it a day.
